006498: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_memory_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, CToken token)
006499: {
006500:     IrType* place_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local->type);
006501:     bool atomic = place_type && place_type->is_atomic;
006502:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006503:     if (atomic && !builder->preparing_calls && c_ir_wide_atomic_runtime_required(builder, local->type))
006504:     {
006505:         result = c_ir_emit_wide_atomic_runtime_load(builder, local->place, local->type, c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token),
006506:                                                     IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL);
006507:     }
006508:     else
006509:     {
006510:         // The named-local load reads a qualified place at its unqualified type the
006511:         // same way c_ir_emit_load_place_raw does; the two must agree or the same
006512:         // object read through the two paths produces two different value types.
006513:         IrTypeId result_type = place_type && (atomic || place_type->is_volatile) ? place_type->unqualified_type : local->type;
006514:         result = c_ir_add_result(builder, result_type);
006515:         if (local->place.value < builder->function->value_count)
006516:         {
006517:             c_ir_label_metadata_copy_for_place(builder, local->place);
006518:             builder->function->values[result.value].points_to_read_only = builder->function->values[local->place.value].points_to_read_only;
006519:             if (builder->label_metadata_enabled)
006520:             {
006521:                 ir_label_provenance_load(builder->arena, builder->function, result, local->place);
006522:             }
006523:         }
006524:         IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 1);
006525:         operands[0] = local->place;
006526:         IrSourceRange instruction_source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
006527:         IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(atomic ? IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD : IR_OPCODE_LOAD, result_type);
006528:         instruction.operands = operands;
006529:         instruction.operand_count = 1;
006530:         instruction.canonical_local = local->id;
006531:         instruction.result = result;
006532:         instruction.memory_order = atomic ? IR_MEMORY_ORDER_SEQUENTIAL : IR_MEMORY_ORDER_COUNT;
006533:         instruction.volatile_access = local->place.value < builder->function->value_count && builder->function->values[local->place.value].is_volatile;
006534:         IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
006535:         builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
006536:     }
006537:     return result;
006538: }

006540: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_load(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local, CToken token)
006541: {

006544:                              : c_ir_emit_memory_load(builder, local, token);

006553: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId type_id)
006554: {
006555:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type_id);
006556:     return type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && type->bit_width == 16 && type->float_format == IR_FLOAT_FORMAT_IEEE;

006559: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId left, IrValueId right, IrTypeId type,
006560:                                                          IrBinaryOperation operation, IrSourceRange source)
006561: {
006562:     IrValueId result = c_ir_add_result(builder, type);
006563:     IrValueId* operands = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrValueId, 2);
006564:     operands[0] = left;
006565:     operands[1] = right;
006566:     IrSourceRange instruction_source = source;
006567:     IrInstruction instruction = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_BINARY, type);
006568:     instruction.operands = operands;
006569:     instruction.operand_count = 2;
006570:     instruction.binary_operation = (u8)operation;
006571:     instruction.result = result;
006572:     IrInstructionId id = c_ir_append_instruction(builder, instruction, instruction_source);
006573:     builder->function->values[result.value].definition = id;
006574:     return result;
006575: }

006577: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_binary_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId left, IrValueId right, IrTypeId type, IrBinaryOperation operation,
006578:                                                      IrSourceRange source)
006579: {
006580:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
006581:     IrTypeId left_type = left.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[left.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006582:     IrTypeId right_type = right.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[right.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006583:     bool binary16_operands = c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, left_type) && c_ir_type_is_ieee_binary16(builder, right_type);
006584:     bool arithmetic = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_ADD || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_SUBTRACT || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_MULTIPLY ||
006585:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_DIVIDE;
006586:     bool comparison = operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS ||
006587:                       operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS_EQUAL || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER || operation == IR_BINARY_FLOAT_GREATER_EQUAL;
006588:     if (binary16_operands && (arithmetic || comparison))
006589:     {
006590:         IrValueId left_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, left, left_type, source);
006591:         IrValueId right_wide = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__extendhfsf2"), builder->f32_type, right, right_type, source);
006592:         if (left_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && right_wide.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006593:         {
006594:             IrValueId wide_result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left_wide, right_wide, comparison ? type : builder->f32_type, operation, source);
006595:             if (comparison)
006596:             {
006597:                 result = wide_result;
006598:             }
006599:             else if (wide_result.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
006600:             {
006601:                 result = c_ir_emit_float16_runtime_call(builder, S8("__truncsfhf2"), type, wide_result, builder->f32_type, source);
006602:             }
006603:         }
006604:     }
006605:     else
006606:     {
006607:         result = c_ir_emit_binary_value_raw(builder, left, right, type, operation, source);
006608:     }
006609:     return result;
006610: }

006612: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrField* c_ir_bit_field_from_place(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId place)
006613: {
006614:     if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
006615:     {
006616:         return 0;
006617:     }
006618:     IrInstructionId definition = builder->function->values[place.value].definition;
006619:     if (definition.value >= builder->function->instruction_count)
006620:     {
006621:         return 0;
006622:     }
006623:     IrInstruction* field_instruction = builder->function->instructions + definition.value;
006624:     if (field_instruction->opcode != IR_OPCODE_FIELD || field_instruction->operand_count != 1 || field_instruction->immediate_count != 1 ||
006625:         field_instruction->operands[0].value >= builder->function->value_count)
006626:     {
006627:         return 0;
006628:     }
006629:     IrType* aggregate = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[field_instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type);
006630:     u64 field_index = field_instruction->immediates[0];
006631:     IrField* result;
006632:     if (!aggregate || field_index >= aggregate->field_count || !aggregate->fields[field_index].is_bit_field)
006633:     {
006634:         result = 0;
006635:     }
006636:     else
006637:     {
006638:         result = aggregate->fields + field_index;
006639:     }
006640: 
006641:     return result;
006642: }

006644: // The unsigned scalar type spanning `size` bytes, which is the type a narrowed
006645: // packed bit-field's storage unit is read and written through: unsigned so the
006646: // raw load zero-extends and the other members' bits in the unit cannot reach
006647: // the extracted value's sign.
006648: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_unsigned_type_of_size(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u64 size)
006649: {
006650:     CTypeKind kinds[] = {C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG, C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG};
006651:     IrTypeId result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
006652:     for (u32 index = 0; result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && index < BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(kinds); index += 1)
006653:     {
006654:         IrTypeId candidate = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, kinds[index]);
006655:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, candidate);
006656:         if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_INTEGER && type->layout.resolved && type->layout.size == size)
006657:         {
006658:             result = candidate;
006659:         }
006660:     }
006661: 
006662:     return result;
006663: }
